items.title: AFCS: Helionix AFCS and VMS Failure Logic
items.description: How the H145 D3's Helionix Automatic Flight Control System and Vehicle Management System are built up layer by layer, followed through a real flight to show how the modes actually work together — plus every AFCS/VMS failure mode.

items.title: Fire: Emergency and Manual Logic
items.description: How the H145 D3's fire detection and extinguishing system is built, followed through a real engine fire to show every automatic and manual step from first indication to a safe outcome.

items.title: HTAWS: Logic and Limitations
items.description: How the H145 D3's terrain awareness and warning system thinks — its modes, database limitations, and alert priorities — followed through a real terrain event from first alert to resolution.
